description: t01 direct boot on i76.exe. From the hand-over (car at ~24 m/s) three airborne spells through fr_probe --place's write path: `launch` lifts the player object 1.5 m and sets the velocity's y to 12 m/s with x/z kept (a ramp exit at the current heading and speed: ~2.4 s of flight, apex ~7 m), `lift` raises the parked car 20 m and lets it fall (fr_probe --drop 20: 2.0 s, vy -19.6 at the ground). Each spell must set the airborne flag 0x4 (ent+0x454) and end in a landing (flag clears; physics.md: air branch of physics_IntegrateVehicleMotion, gravity -9.8, land when clearance < 0.5 m). The watch thread logs every airborne transition with its frame; the checks need > 40 airborne frames (2 s at 20 fps) before the end. t01 ends when the car comes within 50 m of 'groove' (data\out\fsm\t01.fsm), about 45 s after the hand-over, so everything happens in the first 30 s.
